Definition: Hodavjah, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hodaviah is the name of three Israelites. In Ezra 2:40, the text says "of the children of Hodaviah." The life behind the name is told on the Hodaviah People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hodaviah matters because God knows His people by name, and Hodaviah is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
